relations.rationale: The pottery class schedule provides context but does not affect whether Noor arrives first.
The class schedule has no bearing on relative ages of Fay and Ben.
If Alma is the treasurer, then it is impossible for Alma to not be the treasurer.
Alma's role as treasurer is unrelated to Noor's habit of arriving early.
Alma being treasurer has no connection to Ben's apartment location.
Alma not being treasurer is unrelated to Milo's speed finishing pieces.
Noor arriving first is a separate fact from Ben's tendency to arrive late; they could both be true but one doesn't imply the other.
Noor setting up early has no bearing on who took the photographs.
Noor's early arrival is unrelated to Delia's habit of checking centering technique.
Noor arriving first to set up doesn't relate to her height compared to others.
Noor's punctuality has no bearing on her age relative to Ben.
Noor's early setup routine is unrelated to the end-of-term display of finished pottery.
Ben arriving late most weeks is consistent with and supports the idea that he's often shaking off rain from having just arrived.
Ben's lateness is unrelated to Delia's personality as instructor.
Ben's tendency to arrive late is unrelated to his skill difficulties on the wheel.
Ben's lateness doesn't affect whether he improves with practice.
Ben's rain-soaked arrival is unrelated to who took the photographs.
Ben shaking off rain upon arrival is unrelated to his struggles with centering clay.
Ben often being wet from rain upon arrival suggests he walks outside, which is consistent with living nearby, supporting a short walk.
Milo taking photographs is unrelated to the shelves being lined with finished pottery.
